_about: Our own short descriptions and notes (project-owned). Facts cite where they come from. Confidence: CONFIRMED_MULTI_SOURCE, HIGH_CONFIDENCE or HYPOTHESIS.

SetProjectileSource.summary: Changes the owner (source) of a projectile: the hit then counts as that actor's attack. Call it on the projectile ref. Used to reflect or steal arrows and spells.
SetProjectileSource.source: xOBSE source (Commands_MiscReference.cpp) + docs/14 (Projectile Manipulating Magic, Fearsome Magicka)

GetProjectileSource.summary: Returns the actor that fired a projectile (its source).

GetProjectileType.summary: Returns the kind of projectile: arrow, magic ball, bolt or fog.

SetVelocity.summary: Sets a reference's velocity along x, y, z. On projectiles this re-aims them, or stops (freezes) them in mid-air with 0 0 0.

SetProjectileSpeed.summary: Sets a projectile's speed; 0 holds it in place.

GetMagicProjectileSpell.summary: Returns the spell carried by a magic projectile.

SetMagicProjectileSpell.summary: Swaps the spell a magic projectile carries.

GetProjectileLifetime.summary: Returns how long a projectile has existed, in seconds.

GetFirstRef.summary: Finds nearby references: starts a scan over references in the current cell (and neighbouring cells with cell depth). Pass a form type to filter: 34 = projectiles in docs/14's specimens. Continue with GetNextRef until it returns 0.
GetFirstRef.example:
set r to GetFirstRef 34 1
while r
  ; ... use r ...
  set r to GetNextRef
loop

GetNextRef.summary: Returns the next reference of the scan started by GetFirstRef, or 0 when done.

GetNumRefs.summary: Counts references of a form type in the current cell (same filters as GetFirstRef).

IsKeyPressed.summary: Old key check that takes a Windows virtual-key code. Prefer IsKeyPressed3.
IsKeyPressed.params_note: int = Windows virtual-key code (not a DirectInput scan code).

IsKeyPressed2.summary: Returns 1 while a key or mouse button is held down. Takes a DirectInput scan code; ignores keys a script has disabled.
IsKeyPressed2.params_note: int = DirectInput (DIK) scan code, e.g. 28 = Enter, 57 = Space; mouse buttons are 256 and up (256 = left).

IsKeyPressed3.summary: Reads whether a key or mouse button is physically pressed, even if the key was disabled with DisableKey. The usual choice for hotkeys.
IsKeyPressed3.params_note: int = DirectInput (DIK) scan code of the key, e.g. 28 = Enter, 57 = Space; mouse buttons are 256 and up (256 = left).
IsKeyPressed3.source: xOBSE source (Commands_Input.cpp) + docs/14 (Pocket Dimension Player Home uses it)

IsControlPressed.summary: Checks a game control (e.g. Activate, Jump) instead of a raw key, so it follows the player's key bindings.
IsControlPressed.params_note: int = control code (0 = Forward ... see OBSE docs).

GetKeyPress.summary: Returns the scan code of the n-th key currently held (0 = first).

DisableKey.summary: Stops the game from reacting to a key; scripts can still read it with IsKeyPressed3.

SetEventHandler.summary: Registers a user function script to run on an engine event (e.g. OnHit, OnActivate, LoadGame), optionally filtered.

GetFormFromMod.summary: Looks up a form by plugin file name and its FormID within that plugin, so a soft dependency needs no master.

IsModLoaded.summary: Returns 1 if the named plugin is active. Use for soft dependencies.

CloneForm.summary: Creates a new runtime copy of a base form (saved in the savegame as an FF-index form). Used to make editable spell copies.

SetNthEffectItemMagnitude.summary: Changes the magnitude of one effect inside a spell or enchantment at runtime.

RunBatchScript.summary: Runs a text file of console commands (often used for INI-style mod configuration).

GetCrosshairRef.summary: Returns the reference under the crosshair (within activation range).

SetPos.summary: Vanilla: moves a reference along one axis to an absolute coordinate in its current cell.
SetPos.source: vanilla command (obse.vim list) + docs/14 (Portal, PJ's Spell Compendium)

SetAngle.summary: Vanilla: sets a reference's rotation on one axis, in degrees.

MoveTo.summary: Vanilla: moves a reference (or the player) to another reference, across cells and worldspaces, with optional offsets.

PositionWorld.summary: Vanilla: places a reference at x, y, z and z-rotation in a named worldspace. Used to send the player back to a stored return point.
PositionWorld.source: vanilla command + docs/14 (Dimensional Pocket, Pocket Dimension Player Home)

PositionCell.summary: Vanilla: places a reference at x, y, z and z-rotation inside a named interior cell.
PositionCell.source: vanilla command + docs/14 (Pocket Dimension Player Home)

PlaceAtMe.summary: Vanilla: spawns a new reference of a base object at the calling reference. Each call adds a saved reference; avoid in loops.

PushActorAway.summary: Vanilla (1.2): knocks an actor away from the calling reference with a force value.
PushActorAway.source: vanilla command (added in game patch 1.2, per xOBSE CommandTable.cpp) + docs/14 (Telekinetic Damage)

ForceWeather.summary: Vanilla: switches the current weather to a WTHR record; the optional flag overrides region weather until released.
ForceWeather.source: vanilla command + docs/14 (Weather Control Spells, PJ's Spell Compendium)

SetWeather.summary: Vanilla: sets the weather to a WTHR record with a normal transition.

ReleaseWeatherOverride.summary: Vanilla: ends a ForceWeather override so regions control weather again.

CreateFullActorCopy.summary: Vanilla: creates a copy of an actor including inventory; returns the new reference.
CreateFullActorCopy.source: vanilla command (return type recorded in xOBSE CommandTable.cpp) + docs/14

Resurrect.summary: Vanilla: brings a dead actor back to life (optionally with an animation).

SetActorsAI.summary: Vanilla (1.2): stops an actor moving and acting by switching its AI processing off (0); 1 switches it back on. Useful for time-stop effects.
SetActorsAI.source: vanilla command (added in game patch 1.2, per xOBSE CommandTable.cpp)

SetRigidBodyMass.summary: Vanilla: changes the Havok mass of a physics object.

crash_signatures.title: Stuck on the Persuasion tutorial (controller)
crash_signatures.symptoms: The vanilla Persuasion tutorial, page 3 ('The potential gain or loss...'), ignores the gamepad under NorthernUI. Mouse clicks and Enter on their own do nothing. Looks like a hang, but the game is running.
crash_signatures.cause: NorthernUI's controller input doesn't reach that vanilla tutorial page; only arrow keys and Enter work in that menu.
crash_signatures.fix: With the tutorial on top, press keyboard Down to focus Continue, then Enter. One-time.

crash_signatures.title: Elys Silent Voice does nothing: DLL in the wrong folder
crash_signatures.symptoms: Unvoiced dialogue lines flash past (no silent voice padding). No error.
crash_signatures.cause: The Elys_USV.dll was deployed to the Data root, so xOBSE never loaded it. xOBSE plugins load only from Data\OBSE\Plugins.
crash_signatures.fix: Install Elys_USV.dll/.lip/.mp3 into Data\OBSE\Plugins. Don't copy its bundled Construction Set Extender.dll into the game.

crash_signatures.title: Hang linked to the Oblivion Reloaded (ORC) FPS limiter
crash_signatures.cause: Reported as a known cause: the Oblivion Reloaded frame-rate limiter. The setting name, conditions and confirming evidence are not yet written up in agent-docs.
crash_signatures.fix: Not documented yet. Capture a freeze report with Controller\oblivion_freeze.py and record it here.
crash_signatures.source: Phase 2 brief (Yuri, 2026-10-06); no repo write-up yet
